beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Buddy now installs just for you on Windows, so updates stop asking for permission. If an older copy is still installed for everyone on this computer, Buddy offers Remove it or Not now. Once it is removed, other teachers on that computer install Buddy for themselves.
• Checking, downloading and preparing an update all happen in the update window. Downloads have a real Cancel, and an update you put off comes back through the banner.
• The grading page's bottom band is one paper surface. Page tools sit on their own tab, and a thumbnail's grip shows only while the pointer is over it.
• The grade comment sits in the grading row and grows as you type, then folds when you click away. On the Chat tab it waits as a dashed bubble until you choose Post to thread or Keep with the grade.
• Task has its own tab between Chat and Rubric, and Chat runs the full height of the panel with the reply box at the bottom.
• The demo tour brings each step's screen forward and hands you a worksheet to drag on the drop step. Its slides always play.
• Automatic pre-grading now skips only work already graded in Schoology, and pre-grades everything else in any learning period. Turn it on or off from the To-do menu.
• A pre-grade with any model output shows it with a banner instead of stopping. One that does stop says why and what to do next.
• Reading & AI: click anywhere on a None, OCR only or OCR + AI card. Auto-configure says what this computer can run and suggests a model that fits.
• Grade and Choose work the same way across learning periods, and a student's row unfolds out of its header as one motion. Work not yet graded opens in Grade, and a missing upload offers Check upload.
• The Appearance, PDF output and Schoology settings pages are tidier, with matching controls and aligned rows.
• The welcome wizard's folder step shows the records it found as one clear card, and the setup screens share one look.

Fixes:
• Up and down arrows on number boxes respond when clicked.
• The window no longer freezes briefly at a session's first message, and report card progress stays smooth while a job runs.
• Long student names in To-do shorten with an ellipsis instead of being cut off.
• Checking an update's signature no longer flashes a console window.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Compare: when a course has more than one paper that could be the LP's work sample, Compare shows them as ranked cards with the best match on top, beside one large view of the card you pick. You can fix a candidate's pages there (rotate, reorder, delete, combine or patch them) before you choose it. Buddy edits its own copy, never the downloaded original, and the changes go with the paper if you choose it.
• Next follows how you started. Open grading from a student's course and Buddy stays with that student: that course's papers for this LP, then its work sample, then the student's next course, then the rest of To-do. Open it from To-do and it follows To-do's order.
• As Next moves through a student's courses, a course with only one possible work sample goes straight to verifying it. Compare appears only when there is a real choice.
• When a course has ungraded work dated in another LP, Buddy lists it after that course and asks whether to review it. Reviewing grades it where it is; it is not moved into this LP. Skip goes straight to the next course.
• Clicking a course opens Grade first when it has Schoology work this LP that is not yet graded in both Buddy and Schoology, downloading anything not yet downloaded on the way in.
• A Schoology paper can be the work sample only when it is graded in both Buddy and Schoology.
• When a student's RoboSpark class has no samples because its instructor never connected it, the empty course card says so and offers Request work samples.
• If your learning-period dates for this school year have not come from Pathways, Buddy fills them in from the district's published school calendar. It never changes dates from Pathways or dates you set.
• Changing your work folder uses the same look as setup. If the new folder doesn't have your samples, Buddy asks whether to keep your records (copy your samples over, or go back to the old folder) or start fresh. Starting fresh archives your records and deletes nothing. Bring them back from Settings > Workspace & data > Restore an archive.
• While you patch, the cursor is an outline of the brush, so you can see exactly what it will cover.

Fixes:
• Buddy no longer fails to start when a Google Drive folder refuses a permission check.
• If Google Drive comes back under a different drive letter, Buddy offers to use your work folder there.
• Choosing a different folder from the "Can't reach your work folder" bar now says why when Buddy can't use it, instead of seeming to do nothing.
• A new work folder without your samples (for example a new Google Drive shortcut folder) no longer leaves you stuck at "Can't reach your work folder": the bar lets you keep your records or start fresh there.
• Saving a work sample no longer fails for courses whose name includes a time such as "9:00 AM". When a save fails for a common reason (the file is open in another program, the path is too long, the folder is offline), the message says so and what to do.
• Opening Compare from a course always starts on the best match.
• Compare no longer calls a paper "Not turned in" when it just hasn't downloaded yet, and a card updates when its PDF is downloaded again.
• The blue student band shows the preferred name, as the red header does.
• Choosing a paper that was marked as not a work sample now uses it as the sample (while the LP isn't finalized).
• The page viewer fits the page without unneeded scrollbars.
